title: Dollar liquidity, gold reserves, and US monetary spillovers in a fragmenting world
title_zh: 美元流动性、黄金储备与碎片化世界中的美国货币溢出效应
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Central banks are rethinking reserve portfolios as geopolitical fragmentation raises concerns about the accessibility of foreign-held assets, while dollar-funding stress keeps the US dollar at the centre of global financial stability. Using high-frequency US monetary policy surprises and minute-level exchange rates for 18 economies, this column shows that dollar and gold reserves are associated with smaller currency depreciations, especially where official dollar-liquidity backstops are absent and dollar liabilities are large. The findings highlight the importance of maintaining liquidity in the currencies where stress is likely, alongside sound domestic funding structures, credible policy frameworks, and prudent limits on unhedged foreign currency debt.
abstract_zh: 随着地缘政治碎片化加剧，各国央行对境外持有资产的可及性产生担忧，而美元融资压力则使美元始终处于全球金融稳定的核心位置。本文利用高频美国货币政策冲击数据及18个经济体的分钟级汇率数据，发现美元与黄金储备与较小的货币贬值幅度相关，尤其在缺乏官方美元流动性支持且美元负债规模较大的经济体中更为显著。研究结果强调，在维持可能承压货币流动性的同时，还需构建稳健的国内融资结构、可信的政策框架，并对未对冲外币债务设置审慎限额。

title: From Stocks to Flows: Debt Service and Fiscal Sustainability
authors: Barry Eichengreen, Maxime Menuet, Gregory Donnat
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We revisit fiscal sustainability through the lens of the government’s budget constraint. What constrains fiscal policy is not the stock of outstanding liabilities per se, but the fiscal cost of servicing debt. Using two centuries of U.S. fiscal data (1800–2023) and a long-run panel of advanced economies, we show that primary surpluses are systematically more closely associated with debt-service burdens, while debt ratios lose explanatory power when debt service is taken into account. Fiscal responses intensify when financing conditions deteriorate, specifically when the interest-growth differential is positive. We rationalize these findings using a simple flow-based framework in which debt stabilization depends on the responsiveness of fiscal surpluses to financing pressures. The results suggest that fiscal sustainability depends less on debt thresholds than on financing regimes and governments’ ability to absorb debt-service burdens.

title: Compensation vs. Reinforcement: Experimental Identification of Parental Aversion to Inequality in Offspring
title_zh: 补偿与强化：父母对子女不平等厌恶的实验识别
authors: Felipe Barrera-Osorio, Leonardo Bonilla-Mejía, Matias Busso, Sebastian Galiani, Hyunjae Kang, Juan S. Muñoz-Morales, Juan Pantano
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Parents may invest differently across children by compensating the disadvantaged child or by reinforcing the child with higher expected returns. We study this question using a conditional cash transfer experiment that uniquely randomized transfers at the student level, generating exogenous variation in transfer exposure across siblings within the same household. The transfers increased short-run attendance among treated students but generated negative spillovers on untreated siblings: untreated siblings of treated students were 3.7 percentage points less likely to graduate from college, a decline of about 30 percent relative to the control mean. We interpret these effects using a dynamic model of household schooling decisions that identifies parental aversion to inequality in children’s educational outcomes. The estimated model implies limited aversion to inequality in children’s educational outcomes and reproduces held-out treatment effects not used in estimation. A decomposition shows that the negative spillover is primarily driven by substitution in educational investments toward the treated child.
abstract_zh: 父母可能会通过补偿处于劣势的孩子或强化预期回报更高的孩子，在不同子女间进行差异化投资。我们利用一项在个体学生层面随机分配转移支付的现金转移实验来研究这一问题，该实验在同一家庭内的兄弟姐妹间产生了外生的转移支付暴露差异。转移支付提高了受助学生的短期出勤率，但对未受助的兄弟姐妹产生了负面溢出效应：受助学生的未受助兄弟姐妹大学毕业的可能性降低了3.7个百分点，相对于对照组均值下降了约30%。我们通过一个家庭学校教育决策的动态模型来解释这些效应，该模型识别出父母对子女教育成果不平等的规避程度。估计模型表明，父母对子女教育成果不平等的规避程度有限，并复现了未用于估计的保留样本中的处理效应。分解分析显示，负面溢出效应主要由教育投资向受助子女的替代效应驱动。

title: On the 75th anniversary of Musgrave’s distribution of tax payments by income groups
title_zh: 穆斯卡夫按收入群体划分税收负担分配理论75周年纪念
abstract: Abstract Richard Musgrave et al.’s “Distribution of Tax Payments by Income Groups” (1951) provided the first postwar estimates of the distribution of the fiscal burden, concluding the tax system was not as progressive as statutory rates suggested. Drawing from original archival material, we reconstruct the intellectual context of Musgrave’s study, the methodological debates it gave rise to, and assess its legacy in public finance. The study’s legacy is examined through the rise of econometric estimation, applied general equilibrium modeling, and microdata-based approaches, as well as its influence on policy institutions in the USA and abroad. Despite major advances in data and modeling, we argue that key issues raised by Musgrave—particularly the definition of the income basis and the incidence of the corporate income tax—remain unresolved. The enduring lack of consensus on a uniquely best method highlights both the empirical and normative challenges at the heart of distributional analysis and explains the study’s continued relevance in contemporary debates on taxation and income inequality.
abstract_zh: 理查德·马斯格雷夫等人于1951年发表的《按收入群体划分的税收负担分配》提供了战后首批财政负担分配估算，结论表明税收制度并未如法定税率所示那般具有累进性。基于原始档案材料，我们重构了马斯格雷夫研究的学术背景、由此引发的方法论争论，并评估了其在公共财政领域的学术遗产。通过计量经济学估计、应用一般均衡建模、基于微观数据的方法的兴起，以及该研究对美国及海外政策机构的影响，我们审视了其学术遗产。尽管数据与建模技术取得重大进展，我们认为马斯格雷夫提出的关键问题——特别是收入基础的定义与企业所得税的归宿——仍未得到解决。对唯一最优方法长期缺乏共识，凸显了分配分析核心的经验与规范挑战，也解释了该研究在当代税收与收入不平等辩论中持续具有相关性的原因。

title: Asset price bubbles and systemic risk in money market funds
authors: Aquilina, Matteo, Cincinelli, Peter, Urga, Giovanni
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We investigate the systemic risk contribution of 3,500 Money Market Funds (MMFs) in normal periods and during asset price bubbles in the US from January 2004 to December 2022. Using state-of-the-art statistical techniques for bubble detection and granular fund-level data, we show that MMF characteristics significantly influence systemic risk. Large MMFs and government MMFs, which invest exclusively in US Treasury securities, are associated with reduced systemic risk, while prime MMFs contribute to higher systemic risk. MMFs denominated in US dollars but domiciled offshore exhibit no significant differences from their US-domiciled counterparts.

title: Costly regulation, minimal results: The EU’s deforestation regulation effect on global soy trade
title_zh: 高成本监管，低效结果：欧盟毁林法规对全球大豆贸易的影响
abstract: Abstract The European Union Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) seeks to reduce deforestation by restricting market access to deforestation-embodied soy products in the EU market. The main concern is that such restrictions could shift the soy trade to unregulated non-EU markets. To shed light on this issue, we employ a gravity model, treating the EUDR compliance costs as additional trade costs for exports to the EU. We find that stricter compliance costs reallocate soy exports from South America toward non-EU markets, mainly China, divert the EU imports toward North America, and increase the prices of soy faced by EU soy users. Under the counterfactual scenario in which South America does not comply with the regulation, EU consumers face even larger price increases, while South American countries experience minimal terms-of-trade losses. Our analysis suggests that trade reallocation to an unregulated market could potentially dilute the impact of the EUDR, making it less effective in directly reducing deforestation linked to soy production.

title: Open Rule Legislative Bargaining
abstract: Abstract The seminal paper by Baron and Ferejohn (1989) leaves significant gaps in our understanding of open rule bargaining. We aim to fill these gaps by providing a fresh analysis of open rule bargaining. Our approach relies on an appealing class of stationary equilibria. In this class, we show that delays tend to be longer and allocations tend to be less egalitarian than originally predicted by Baron and Ferejohn. Our results shed new light on the efficiency and fairness implications of using an open vs. closed rule in legislatures and of bargaining processes in general.

title: Using Rich Lists to Study the Super-Rich and Top Wealth Inequality: Insights from Switzerland
title_zh: 利用富豪榜研究超级富豪与顶层财富不平等：来自瑞士的启示
abstract: Abstract We present a new data set we built based on Swiss rich lists going back to 1989. We show, among other things, that 60% of the super-rich are heirs—a fraction twice as large as in the United States—and that wealth mobility at the very top has declined significantly. We find that top 0.01% wealth shares are higher than what previous estimates based on wealth tax statistics suggest. At the same time, we argue that rich list data lead to overestimating wealth inequality. Although rich lists are valuable to study the super-rich, we recommend using reported wealth figures with caution.
